texts: Market balance (excess, residual and scope adjustments)
Market balance: building above modelled need (pipeline)
note: Completions = 0.945 x consents lagged 17 months (median consent-to-completion time 1.27-1.53 yr, Jones, Greenaway-McGrevy & Crow 2025; consistent with the Stats NZ Experimental building indicators). Households after the 2023 census = ERP / household-size path (Stats NZ DHE not used). Pipeline years 2026, 2027: building observed (consents to July 2026); the part above modelled need fades from 2028 (ρ = 0.43) and is absorbed by 2035. 2026 population: Stats NZ ERP nowcast. Six display bands (data/bands_display_map.csv); market balance = unexplained building + retirement villages (out of scope) + overbuild / pipeline excess + overbuild absorbed + surplus kept vacant. Negative bands drawn down from zero: Market balance (excess, residual and scope adjustments), Vacancy, Net replacement. 2026-2050: 81.5 Mm².
